units: Prov. XX, 21, cmp. preced.) to hasten. Pi. בִּיחֵל to come early. Mekh. Bo, Pisḥa, 2 בי׳ אביב ובא ed. Livorno (oth. ed. כי חל corr. acc.) when the ripening of grains came very early.

senses.gloss: to advance growth. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top כל דבר שהוא מַבְחִיל (not שהיה מכחיל) whatever is done for advancing the fruits.
